title: Stage 3.4 - real-world pilots (RU tech-lead report)
summary: A/B pilot of the deploom-upgrade skill (with real planning core) vs a bare agent on a real corporate frontend monorepo. Both produced identical clean minimal diffs (exactly 3 requested patch updates, strict exclusions honored, no major bumps; all project checks pass on independent post-run verification). The deploom variant completed the full pipeline in one pass (plan -> isolated worktree -> install -> verify -> structured evidence JSON); the bare-agent variant hit the wall-clock cap in a large npm install and did not finish verification itself. The skill's planner call degraded to needsReview=true because of a registry-metadata provider failure (registry-failed) and honestly requested user approval instead of fabricating targets, so the 'planner confirmed the targets' criterion is not met this run.

setup.experiment: controlled A/B, same baseline commit, same user request (RU), same model, same wall-clock budget per variant; only difference is DepLoom availability
setup.project: real corporate frontend monorepo (npm workspaces + lerna + webpack + jest, React 18, Node 20)
setup.isolation: two separate git worktrees (agent-only, deploom); original checkout never modified; skill used an additional TEMP-side isolated worktree
setup.registry: configured npm registry (internal mirror; public npmjs unreachable in the environment)
setup.task: upgrade exactly postcss(8.x), @types/node(20.x), @types/react(18.x) to latest within major; 58 other dependencies strictly excluded; no commit/push

planning.observation: planner target (metadata snapshot) is older than the live registry version; executor resolved with fresh npm view

planningGateInsideRun.targetsSource: user explicit instruction + direct npm view

verification.testsScriptNote: npm test does not exist in project; test:unit is the real script

agent-only.changedTreeKind: inplace (its own disposable worktree; no automatic isolation)
agent-only.verificationByAgent: NOT_VERIFIED within window (large npm install consumed the budget)
agent-only.methodObserved: npm view<major> -> latest; manual comparison of transitive closure; single full npm install

independentCheck.description: uniform bounded post-run checks in the changed worktree of each variant

criteria.H1_core_solves_real_task: PARTIAL - real core produced a clean plan on the real monorepo/registry (DRAFT_READY, proposed=3) but the in-run planner call failed metadata (registry-failed) and fell back to needsReview; positive re-run required
criteria.H2_ab_value: CONFIRMED - deploom delivered to a releasable result in one pass incl. full verification and evidence; bare agent did not finish verification itself within the same budget
criteria.H3_policy_and_exclusions: CONFIRMED - no excluded dependency touched, no major bumps, lockfile consistent, diff == plan (both variants)
criteria.H4_verifiable_evidence: CONFIRMED for deploom (evidence JSON); for agent-only evidence is absent - only independent check covers it

resilienceFindings.degradation: on registry-metadata failure the skill degraded to plan-on-user-instruction + direct registry lookup, marked needsReview=true and requested user approval - it did not fabricate targets
resilienceFindings.bareAgent: performed the same direct registry lookup silently, without explicit risk flagging or evidence

z3Responsibility.A_planner: decides WHAT and to which version, applies exclusions and yellow policy, emits plan.json and planning gates (real core + MCP boundary)
z3Responsibility.B_agent: applies decisions, runs install and verification (skill pipeline vs bare agent); deploom produced evidence and approval request, agent-only did neither
z3Responsibility.C_controller: this run: diffs == plan, exclusion/major compliance, uniform verification in both worktrees, metrics capture; no violations found

negativeScenarios.realBrokenCases: NOT_RUN (budget constraints, care for corporate code)
negativeScenarios.syntheticPositiveAndNegative: NOT_RUN in this window; covered by Stage 3 E2E (positive fixture 12/12) and contract boundary test suite - evidence committed in Stage 3; scheduled as follow-up
